```{r chart_rtVsUserLoad, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================
# 1. AGGREGATE — avg, p90, p95 RT per user count per run_id
# ============================================================
rt_vs_users <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(run_id, user_index) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rt = round(mean(elapsed, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    p90_rt = round(quantile(elapsed, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    p95_rt = round(quantile(elapsed, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(user_index)) %>%

  arrange(run_id, user_index)

unique_runs <- sort(unique(rt_vs_users$run_id))
set.seed(42)
run_colors  <- setNames(choose_palette(length(unique_runs)), unique_runs)

subtitle_text <- build_run_testname_subtitle(
  raw_data %>% distinct(run_id, test_name)
)

# ============================================================
# 2. BUILD PLOTLY — avg, p90, p95 lines per run_id
# ============================================================
pl <- plot_ly(height = 550)

for (r in unique_runs) {
  run_data  <- rt_vs_users %>% filter(run_id == r)
  col       <- run_colors[[as.character(r)]]

  # Avg RT — solid line
  pl <- pl %>%
    add_trace(
      data      = run_data,
      x         = ~user_index,
      y         = ~avg_rt,
      type      = "scatter",
      mode      = "lines",
      name      = paste0("Avg RT — Run ", r),
      legendgroup = paste0("run_", r),
      line      = list(color = col, width = 2, dash = "solid"),
      text      = ~paste0(
        "Run ID: ",   run_id,
        "\nUsers: ",  user_index,
        "\nAvg RT: ", avg_rt, " ms"
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text"
    )

  # P90 RT — dashed line
  pl <- pl %>%
    add_trace(
      data      = run_data,
      x         = ~user_index,
      y         = ~p90_rt,
      type      = "scatter",
      mode      = "lines",
      name      = paste0("P90 RT — Run ", r),
      legendgroup = paste0("run_", r),
      line      = list(color = col, width = 2, dash = "dash"),
      text      = ~paste0(
        "Run ID: ",   run_id,
        "\nUsers: ",  user_index,
        "\nP90 RT: ", p90_rt, " ms"
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text"
    )

  # P95 RT — dotted line
  pl <- pl %>%
    add_trace(
      data      = run_data,
      x         = ~user_index,
      y         = ~p95_rt,
      type      = "scatter",
      mode      = "lines",
      name      = paste0("P95 RT — Run ", r),
      legendgroup = paste0("run_", r),
      line      = list(color = col, width = 2, dash = "dot"),
      text      = ~paste0(
        "Run ID: ",   run_id,
        "\nUsers: ",  user_index,
        "\nP95 RT: ", p95_rt, " ms"
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text"
    )
}

pl <- pl %>%
  layout(
    title = list(
      text    = paste0(
        "<b>Response Time vs User Load</b>",
        "<br><sup>", subtitle_text, "</sup>"
      ),
      x       = 0,
      xanchor = "left",
      font    = list(size = 14, family = "Consolas", color = "#333")
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title      = "Number of Users",
      fixedrange = TRUE,
      automargin = TRUE,
      titlefont  = list(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333"),
      tickfont   = list(family = "Consolas", size = 10)
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title      = "Response Time (ms)",
      fixedrange = TRUE,
      automargin = TRUE,
      rangemode  = "tozero",
      titlefont  = list(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333"),
      tickfont   = list(family = "Consolas", size = 10)
    ),
    legend = list(
      orientation = "h",
      x           = 0,
      y           = -0.2,
      font        = list(family = "Consolas", size = 10)
    ),
    showlegend = TRUE,
    margin     = list(l = 80, r = 40, b = 120, t = 80),
    dragmode   = FALSE,
    hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "white"),
    height     = 550
  ) %>%
  plotly::config(
    responsive     = TRUE,
    displayModeBar = TRUE,
    toImageButtonOptions = list(
      format   = "png",
      filename = paste0("RT_vs_UserLoad_", Sys.Date()),
      height   = 550,
      width    = 1400
    ),
    modeBarButtonsToRemove = list(
      "zoom2d", "pan2d", "select2d", "lasso2d", "zoomIn2d", "zoomOut2d",
      "autoScale2d", "resetScale2d", "hoverClosestCartesian", "hoverCompareCartesian"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 3. MOUNT HTML VIEWPORT
# ============================================================
htmltools::tagList(
  
  htmltools::tags$div(
    style = "width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 10px;",
    pl
  ),
  render_observation_panel(
    chart_id = "chart_rtVsUserLoad"
  )
)
```
